text.tspan: Threshold income or consumption per year for each decile, 1963 to 2024
The level of income or consumption per person per year below which 10%, 20%, 30%, etc. of the population
falls. This data is adjusted for inflation and differences in living costs between countries.
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)

Note: This data is expressed in
international-$
at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes

and benefits) or to consumption,
per capita
.
